detail.descriptionHtml:
Product Name:

VIP (Vasoactive Intestinal Peptide)

Chemical Information:
  • Molecular Formula: C147H238N44O42S
  • Molecular Weight: ~3,326 g/mol
  • Sequence:His‑Ser‑Asp‑Ala‑Val‑Phe‑Thr‑Asp‑Asn‑Tyr‑Thr‑Arg‑Leu‑Arg‑Lys‑Gln‑Met‑Ala‑Val‑Lys‑Lys‑Tyr‑Leu‑Asn‑Ser‑Ile‑Leu‑Asn‑NH₂
  •  Structure Class: Synthetic 28 amino acid peptide (glucagon/secretin-related peptide)
Molecular Structure:
Product Description:

Vasoactive Intestinal Peptide (VIP) is a 28–amino-acid synthetic peptide belonging to the glucagon/secretin peptide superfamily. It is structurally characterized by a defined linear amino acid sequence and is produced via controlled peptide synthesis for use in laboratory research environments. In research settings, VIP is utilized in analytical and experimental systems to examine peptide structure, stability, and physicochemical properties under controlled conditions. The compound is supplied as a lyophilized powder and is intended exclusively for in vitro use by qualified research professionals.

Research Applications:

VIP is utilized in controlled laboratory research settings for applications such as:

  • Analytical evaluation of peptide structure and sequence characteristics
  • Examination of peptide stability and degradation profiles under controlled conditions
  • Investigation of peptide–receptor binding interactions in isolated assay systems
  • Characterization of peptide behavior in biochemical and cell-based experimental models
Storage and Handling:
  • Store lyophilized powder at −20 °C
  • Once reconstituted, store at 2–8 °C and use promptly
  • Use aseptic techniques during handling; material is not certified sterile
Product Specifications:
  •  Purity: ≥99% (HPLC Certified)
  •  Appearance: White lyophilized powder
  •  Solubility: Soluble in suitable laboratory agents
Compliance Notice:

VIP (Vasoactive Intestinal Peptide) is FOR RESEARCH USE ONLY. It is not intended for human or veterinary use. This product has not been evaluated by the FDA. Misuse of this product is strictly prohibited and may violate federal, state, or local laws. By purchasing this product, buyer represents and warrants that it will be used only for in vitro research purposes.
